description: Allocation of a plot of land to the Embassy of the State of Palestine
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, to allocate a plot of land located in the Hewa Avenue, Colombo 07, to construct a permanent building for the Embassy of the State of Palestine, was approved by the Cabinet.
